creator: DEXPI e.V. and corpus contributors
attribution: Symbol geometry in the DEXPI symbol library is derived from the DEXPI TrainingTestCases example corpus by DEXPI e.V. and corpus contributors, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0).
modifications: SymGov converted each catalogue shape from Proteus XML to an isolated SVG, drew strokes in the page colour rather than the source CAD palette, and limited line weights to a legible range. Source colours and weights are kept with each symbol's provenance. Each SVG carries the creator, licence and source in its own metadata.
clarification: DEXPI publishes no symbol library of its own. These shapes come from vendor and reference example files; they are not the ISO 10628 or ISO 14617 artwork, and DEXPI e.V. does not endorse SymGov.
limitation: The corpus covers DEXPI 1.2 and 1.3 only; no DEXPI 2.0 example set exists. The shape geometry is unchanged from 1.2 to 2.0, so this is a provenance caveat rather than a data-quality one.
